# FPSOT internationalization specification

> How FPSOT products show text, dates and numbers in English, French and any other locale: language tags, negotiation and fallback, CLDR formatting, MessageFormat messages, translation files, text direction, names and addresses.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts, conformance and references.
- [Language tags and locales](spec/en/language-tags.adoc): LOC-001 to LOC-007.
- [Formatting](spec/en/formatting.adoc): LOC-010 to LOC-015.
- [Messages](spec/en/messages.adoc): LOC-020 to LOC-025.
- [Translation](spec/en/translation.adoc): LOC-030 to LOC-036.
- [Text, markup and direction](spec/en/markup.adoc): LOC-040 to LOC-046.
- [Names and addresses](spec/en/names-addresses.adoc): LOC-050 to LOC-055.

- [Make a product ready in English and French](docs/modules/en/pages/index.adoc)
